changes.name: Origin of Margoria
changes.fact: Simple Alchemy consumes one unwanted Margoria Sea Crystal and gives 1–2 Origins. Does not assert a mean or equal probability, or generalize to unopened Margoria Crystal.
Each can be a random 1–2 result from Blue Sea Crystal Box. Crow Coin Shop price 5,000; weekly limit three boxes. Distinct from Deep Sea Crystal Box's 1–3 range and Wavelit exchange.
